apartments.name: The Aurelia Lagoon Penthouse
apartments.shortDescription: Architectural duplex penthouse with panoramic Lagos Lagoon views and private infinity terrace.
apartments.description:
Perched above Banana Island Road in Ikoyi, The Aurelia Lagoon Penthouse exemplifies quiet Nigerian luxury. Crafted with floor-to-ceiling acoustic glazing, bespoke fluted oak cabinetry, and Italian travertine stone, this 3-bedroom residence offers uninterrupted vistas of the Lagos Lagoon.

Designed for C-suite executives, diplomats, and discerning families, the penthouse features 24/7 uninterrupted power via dual Caterpillar generators and solar inverter backup, dedicated fiber-optic Starlink + fiber internet, private elevator access, and an expansive wrap-around sky terrace.
houseRules: No unauthorized parties or commercial shoots
Valid government ID required at check-in
apartments.checkInInstructions: Proceed to Tower A VIP Concierge at 14 Bourdillon Crescent. Mention your Booking Reference to receive your private elevator keycard.

apartments.name: Victoria Crest Oceanfront Loft
apartments.shortDescription: Sun-drenched 2-bedroom executive loft overlooking the Atlantic coastline in Victoria Island.
apartments.description:
Situated in the heart of Victoria Island’s financial and diplomatic district, Victoria Crest Oceanfront Loft pairs industrial-chic double-height ceilings with warm West African contemporary art and tactile linen furnishings.

Enjoy morning espresso on your private balcony facing the Atlantic breeze, work seamlessly with dual-ISP high-speed fiber internet, and unwind in the heated rooftop lap pool.
apartments.address: 28 Adeola Odeku Street, Victoria Island, Lagos
apartments.checkInInstructions: Collect your access fob from the 24-hour front desk at 28 Adeola Odeku Street. Underground parking bay #12 is reserved for your stay.

apartments.name: Maitama Diplomatic Garden Suite
apartments.shortDescription: Serene ground-floor sanctuary with private landscaped courtyard near Maitama embassies.
apartments.description:
Tucked away on a tree-lined avenue in Maitama, Abuja, the Diplomatic Garden Suite offers refined tranquility minutes from the Three Arms Zone and major embassies. Thoughtfully appointed with Nigerian hardwood floors, curated botanical courtyard gardens, and plush king suites.

Ideal for visiting consultants, diplomats, and couples seeking discreet luxury in the Federal Capital Territory.
apartments.checkInInstructions: Gate security at 9 Yedseram Street will verify your booking reference. Use smart lock code provided via SMS/Email to enter Suite G2.

apartments.name: Admiralty Way Executive Studio
apartments.shortDescription: Sleek, smart-enabled 1-bedroom residence steps from Lekki Phase 1 cafes and tech hubs.
apartments.description:
Designed for modern business travelers and remote executives, the Admiralty Way Executive Studio in Lekki Phase 1 blends Scandinavian minimalism with effortless Lagos convenience.

Featuring automated blackout blinds, voice-controlled ambient lighting, an ergonomic Herman Miller workspace, and access to a resident lounge and gym.
apartments.checkInInstructions: Enter through Admiralty Estate Gate 2 and proceed to Block B, 3rd Floor. Smart keypad code is delivered upon booking confirmation.

apartments.name: Wuse II Cosmopolitan Family Residence
apartments.shortDescription: Spacious 3-bedroom luxury residence in central Wuse II with private chef option.
apartments.description:
Located in Abuja’s vibrant Wuse II district, this expansive 3-bedroom all-ensuite residence is tailored for families, corporate delegations, and extended stays.

Each bedroom features custom walk-in wardrobes, spa-inspired rain showers, and acoustic windows. Includes a generous 8-seater dining room, chef’s kitchen, and dedicated 24-hour estate security.
apartments.address: 17 Adetokunbo Ademola Crescent, Wuse II, Abuja
apartments.checkInInstructions: Present your booking reference at the Wuse II Cosmopolitan Towers reception desk. Duty manager will escort you to Suite 402.

apartments.propertyName: New GRA Presidential Villas Port Harcourt
apartments.name: GRA Phase 2 Presidential Villa Suite
apartments.shortDescription: Refined 2-bedroom executive suite in Port Harcourt’s prestigious New GRA.
apartments.description:
Set within a lush, ultra-secure gated enclave in New GRA Phase 2, Port Harcourt, the Presidential Villa Suite delivers five-star hospitality with the privacy of a private home.

Popular with energy-sector executives and diplomatic visitors, the suite includes high-speed fiber connectivity, uninterrupted power, and access to an outdoor lounge and pool.
apartments.address: 6 Forces Avenue Extension, New GRA, Port Harcourt
amenities: Armed Escort / Security Liaison on Request
apartments.checkInInstructions: Report to the Villa Concierge Gatehouse at 6 Forces Avenue Extension with your booking reference and valid photo ID.
